title: Good way to track habits – unlimited habits for free
body:
The gameification aspect of it is nice, I also like that you can track unlimited amounts of habits. 

I guess the ui and so on could be nicer, but it works!
author: __Avocadoman

title: Fun but malfunctioning
body:
It was a pretty fun way to keep track of habits, but grew boring after a month’s time. I had to delete the app as it stopped updating/resetting my dailies each morning. 
When adding new tasks/habits, the app shuffles them around randomly after you sort them. 
It said you could make a party to do quests with other users, but didn’t let you know how to get in contact with others.

author: akalars

title: Awesome!
body: This is a nice and fun way to get things done. Add your to-do list, daily chores, habits that you want to keep track of, anything goes. You get points as you tick off the completed tasks and can unlock fun things. I've tried several to-do list and reminder apps, but I've usually ended up not doing anything from my lists. But with this thing, I've got tons of things done.
